attributes.title: Hud: 5. Investigation Details
attributes.description: One investigation (a failed or slow request, from the hud.forensic logs): summary, exception and throwing function, machine metrics, stack trace and call chain, and the full forensic JSON. Open it from an Investigation id, or from an issue Fingerprint (shows the latest investigation with it).
